name: CURRENCY.PRICE.HISTORICAL
description:
Currency Historical Price. Currency historical data.

Currency historical prices refer to the past exchange rates of one currency against
another over a specific period.
This data provides insight into the fluctuations and trends in the foreign exchange market,
helping analysts, traders, and economists understand currency performance,
evaluate economic health, and make predictions about future movements.

parameters.name: symbol
parameters.description: Symbol to get data for. Can use CURR1-CURR2 or CURR1CURR2 format. Multiple comma separated items allowed.

parameters.name: start_date
parameters.description: Start date of the data, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

parameters.name: end_date
parameters.description: End date of the data, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

parameters.name: interval
parameters.description: Time interval of the data to return. Options: 1m, 5m, 15m, 30m, 1h, 4h, 1d.

name: CURRENCY.SNAPSHOTS
description: Snapshots of currency exchange rates from an indirect or direct perspective of a base currency.

parameters.name: base
parameters.description: The base currency symbol. Multiple comma separated items allowed.

parameters.name: quote_type
parameters.description: Whether the quote is direct or indirect. Selecting 'direct' will return the exchange rate as the amount of domestic currency required to buy one unit of the foreign currency. Selecting 'indirect' (default) will return the exchange rate as the amount of foreign currency required to buy one unit of the domestic currency.

parameters.name: counter_currencies
parameters.description: An optional list of counter currency symbols to filter for. None returns all.

name: DERIVATIVES.OPTIONS.CHAINS
description: Get the complete options chain for a ticker.

parameters.name: symbol
parameters.description: Symbol to get data for.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: The end-of-day date for options chains data.

parameters.name: option_type
parameters.description: The option type, call or put, 'None' is both (default). Options: call, put.

parameters.name: moneyness
parameters.description: Return only contracts that are in or out of the money, default is 'all'. Parameter is ignored when a date is supplied. Options: otm, itm, all.

parameters.name: delay
parameters.description: Whether to return delayed, realtime, or eod data. Options: eod, realtime, delayed.

parameters.name: strike_gt
parameters.description: Return options with a strike price greater than the given value. Parameter is ignored when a date is supplied.

parameters.name: strike_lt
parameters.description: Return options with a strike price less than the given value. Parameter is ignored when a date is supplied.

parameters.name: volume_gt
parameters.description: Return options with a volume greater than the given value. Parameter is ignored when a date is supplied.

parameters.name: volume_lt
parameters.description: Return options with a volume less than the given value. Parameter is ignored when a date is supplied.

parameters.name: oi_gt
parameters.description: Return options with an open interest greater than the given value. Parameter is ignored when a date is supplied.

parameters.name: oi_lt
parameters.description: Return options with an open interest less than the given value. Parameter is ignored when a date is supplied.

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: The pricing model to use for options chains data, default is 'black_scholes'. Parameter is ignored when a date is supplied. Options: black_scholes, bjerk.

parameters.name: show_extended_price
parameters.description: Whether to include OHLC type fields, default is True. Parameter is ignored when a date is supplied.

parameters.name: include_related_symbols
parameters.description: Include related symbols that end in a 1 or 2 because of a corporate action, default is False.

name: ECONOMY.COUNTRY_PROFILE
description: Get a profile of country statistics and economic indicators.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: The country to get data. Multiple comma separated items allowed.

parameters.name: latest
parameters.description: If True, return only the latest data. If False, return all available data for each indicator.

parameters.name: use_cache
parameters.description: If True, the request will be cached for one day.Using cache is recommended to avoid needlessly requesting the same data.

name: ECONOMY.INDICATORS
description: Get economic indicators by country and indicator.

parameters.name: symbol
parameters.description: Symbol to get data for. The base symbol for the indicator (e.g. GDP, CPI, etc.). Multiple comma separated items allowed.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: The country to get data. The country represented by the indicator, if available. Multiple comma separated items allowed.

parameters.name: start_date
parameters.description: Start date of the data, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

parameters.name: end_date
parameters.description: End date of the data, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

parameters.name: transform
parameters.description: tusd` should only be used where values are currencies. Options: toya, tpop, tusd, tpgp.

parameters.name: frequency
parameters.description: The frequency of the data, default is 'quarter'. Only valid when 'symbol' is 'main'. Options: annual, quarter, month.

parameters.name: use_cache
parameters.description: If True, the request will be cached for one day. Using cache is recommended to avoid needlessly requesting the same data.

Get the URLs to SEC filings reported to EDGAR database, such as 10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, and more. SEC
filings include Form 10-K, Form 10-Q, Form 8-K, the proxy statement, Forms 3, 4, and 5, Schedule 13, Form 114,
Foreign Investment Disclosures and others. The annual 10-K report is required to be
filed annually and includes the company's financial statements, management discussion and analysis,
and audited financial statements.
